historical_record.description: Metson Lake, two acres at 185 feet above tide between Twenty-sixth and Thirtieth Avenues in the middle of the park, was filled with water lifted by windmill from wells near the ocean and served, like Spreckels and Lloyd Lakes, as a reservoir.
